selection_rule: Use the 32 next eligible source-order rows [16:48] (zero-based slice) from the pinned B2 KC→MBON05 runtime mask after the original 16 Level 1/replication KCs; preserve all positive-contact rows, with no response-based selection. Map source-order rank linearly to preferred_position=i/(N-1).

circuit.plastic_edge_semantics: one aggregate KC→MBON05 edge per selected KC, representing only its audited B2 plastic contact rows; all edges in this Level 2 subset are locally plastic; other contacts are omitted

encoder.drive_transform: external KC drive = peak_drive_mv * activation_i(x); no future timestamp, time-to-contact, desired action time, future position, or target-region flag enters the encoder
encoder.status: fixed engineering overlay; source-order preferred positions; not anatomically measured tuning

overlay.mbon_activity: maximum subthreshold MBON05 membrane voltage during fixed observation window; engineering readout
overlay.rng_usage: no random draws; seed is a deterministic run identifier

weight_initialization.rule: KC audited plastic-contact count divided by total audited plastic-contact count across all 32 selected KCs
weight_initialization.status: engineering voltage normalization; anatomy counts only determine relative starting weights

evaluation.action_rule: ACTION iff maximum MBON05 voltage <= frozen pretraining controllability threshold

controllability_probe.threshold_selection: For each frozen probe center, reduce only the weights of KCs whose preferred positions are within ±0.10 by fixed factor 0.20. Let L be the maximum MBON05 response over all grid positions within ±0.05 of any probe center; let D be the minimum baseline response over grid positions at least 0.20 from their corresponding center. Freeze threshold=(L+D)/2 only if L<D, the full naive grid is no-action, local regions cross ACTION, distant positions stay no-action, and local matched responses fall. No training outcomes enter this rule.
controllability_probe.threshold_status: derived once from PASS probe before training; training runner refuses missing/failed probe

training.parameter_status: frozen before training; small fixed LTD decrement chosen to expose blockwise changes, not outcome tuned
training.logging: per presentation: position, encoder drive, KC spike counts, MBON response, action, eligibility at teacher, teacher indicator, and each weight change; full frozen position map after each block
training.eligibility_reset_scope: presentation_local: eligibility is initialized at zero at the start of each stimulus presentation, used for that presentation’s teacher pulse, and discarded before the next presentation; weights persist
training.duration_status: fixed at 32 complete blocks; run all blocks without performance-based early stopping

only_changes: eligibility resets to zero at each stimulus presentation boundary; training duration is 32 blocks
